title: Notices for every billing step
body: A trial now sends one factual notice when it starts, another three days before it ends, and one when it lapses without a payment method. Each names the workspace it concerns and links to the page it talks about.

title: Channel problems reach you by email
body: An expired channel token or a post that has stopped retrying now sends the workspace owner an email instead of waiting to be noticed in the app. At most one per channel and kind per day, naming how many posts are affected.

title: Mastodon instance rules
body: Connecting a Mastodon account now warns when the account is not marked as automated. Many instances require that for unattended posting and suspend accounts that are not.

title: Renamed to Postial
body: Product renamed to Postial (formerly known under a different name). API paths and webhook compatibility unchanged.

title: Notifications
body: In-app notifications and optional Slack, Discord and Mattermost webhook alerts.

title: Channel health
body: Connection health checks and a shared overview of channels needing attention.

title: Agency teams
body: Invite teammates by link and manage access within the included team allowance.

title: Image uploads
body: Upload images, add alt text and preview supported network formats.

title: API and webhooks
body: Agency REST API and signed webhooks. n8n-nodes-socialmint 0.1.2 is published on npm and appears as Postial in n8n; only the package name retains the former brand.

title: Client approval links
body: Clients can approve or request changes through a private link without an account.

title: Publishing core and adapters
body: Brand workspaces, calendar and publishing status with Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram adapters.

title: Landing and billing
body: Public pricing, interactive approval demo, Stripe trial checkout, Google sign-in and magic links.
